features.notes: Shipped in 8aa0ffa. backend/analytics/summarise.py with the four deliberate constraints: MAX_SAMPLE_TURNS=200 hard cap; group-code redaction (real codes -> G1/G2/...) before LLM sees them; paraphrase-strict gemini-2.5-flash prompt; post-LLM verbatim-substring filter (VERBATIM_THRESHOLD=40).
